description: Command line tool and library for transferring data with URLs.

global_option.name: --abstract-unix-socket
tip: Connect via abstract Unix domain socket.

global_option.name: --alt-svc
tip: Enable alt-svc with this cache file.

global_option.name: --append
tip: Append to target file when uploading.

global_option.name: --ca-native
tip: Load CA certs from the OS.

global_option.name: --cacert
tip: CA certificate to verify peer against.

global_option.name: --capath
tip: CA directory to verify peer against.

global_option.name: --connect-to
tip: Connect to host2 instead of host1.

global_option.name: --cookie
tip: Send cookies from string/load from file.

global_option.name: --create-file-mode
tip: Set the file mode for created files.

global_option.name: --crlf
tip: Convert LF to CRLF in upload.

global_option.name: --curves
tip: (EC) TLS key exchange algorithms to request.

global_option.name: --dns-interface
tip: Interface to use for DNS requests.

global_option.name: --dns-ipv4-addr
tip: IPv4 address to use for DNS requests.

global_option.name: --dns-ipv6-addr
tip: IPv6 address to use for DNS requests.

global_option.name: --doh-cert-status
tip: Verify DoH server cert status OCSP-staple.

global_option.name: --dump-ca-embed
tip: Write the embedded CA bundle to standard output.

global_option.name: --ech
tip: Specify how to do ECH (Encrypted Client Hello)

global_option.name: --egd-file
tip: (deprecated) EGD socket path for random data.

global_option.name: --etag-save
tip: Parse incoming ETag and save to a file.

global_option.name: --fail
tip: Fail fast with no output on HTTP errors.

global_option.name: --fail-with-body
tip: Fail on HTTP errors but save the body.

global_option.name: --follow
tip: Follow redirects per spec, keeping the custom request method

global_option.name: --ftp-create-dirs
tip: Create the remote dirs if not present.

global_option.name: --ftp-skip-pasv-ip
tip: Skip the IP address for PASV.

global_option.name: --ftp-ssl-control
tip: Require TLS for login, clear for transfer.

global_option.name: --get
tip: Put the post data in the URL and use GET.

global_option.name: --haproxy-protocol
tip: Send HAProxy PROXY protocol v1 header.

global_option.name: --hostpubmd5
tip: Acceptable MD5 hash of host public key.

global_option.name: --hostpubsha256
tip: Acceptable SHA256 hash of host public key.

global_option.name: --hsts
tip: Enable HSTS with this cache file.

global_option.name: --ignore-content-length
tip: Ignore the size of the remote resource.

global_option.name: --ip-tos
tip: Set IP Type of Service or Traffic Class.

global_option.name: --junk-session-cookies
tip: Ignore session cookies read from file.

global_option.name: --libcurl
tip: Generate libcurl code for this command line.

global_option.name: --local-port
tip: Use a local port number within RANGE.

global_option.name: --location-trusted
tip: As --location, but send secrets to other hosts.

global_option.name: --mail-auth
tip: Originator address of the original email.

global_option.name: --mail-rcpt-allowfails
tip: Allow RCPT TO command to fail.

global_option.name: --metalink
tip: (deprecated) Process given URLs as metalink XML file.

global_option.name: --netrc
tip: Must read .netrc for username and password.

global_option.name: --netrc-file
tip: Specify the file to use for netrc

global_option.name: --next
tip: Make next URL use separate options.

global_option.name: --no-buffer
tip: Disable buffering of the output stream.

global_option.name: --no-clobber
tip: Do not overwrite files that already exist.

global_option.name: --no-keepalive
tip: Disable TCP keepalive on the connection.

global_option.name: --no-progress-meter
tip: Do not show the progress meter.

global_option.name: --noproxy
tip: List of hosts which do not use proxy.

global_option.name: --out-null
tip: Discard response data into the void.

global_option.name: --output
tip: Write to file instead of stdout.

global_option.name: --parallel-max-host
tip: Maximum connections to a single host.

global_option.name: --path-as-is
tip: Do not squash .. sequences in URL path.

global_option.name: --pinnedpubkey
tip: Public key to verify peer against.

global_option.name: --post301
tip: Do not switch to GET after a 301 redirect.

global_option.name: --post302
tip: Do not switch to GET after a 302 redirect.

global_option.name: --post303
tip: Do not switch to GET after a 303 redirect.

global_option.name: --progress-bar
tip: Display transfer progress as a bar.

global_option.name: --proto-default
tip: Use PROTOCOL for any URL missing a scheme.

global_option.name: --proxy-basic
tip: Use Basic authentication on the proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-ca-native
tip: Load CA certs from the OS to verify proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-cacert
tip: CA certificates to verify proxy against.

global_option.name: --proxy-capath
tip: CA directory to verify proxy against.

global_option.name: --proxy-cert-type
tip: Client certificate type for HTTPS proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-ciphers
tip: TLS 1.2 (1.1, 1.0) ciphers to use for proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-crlfile
tip: Set a CRL list for proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-key-type
tip: Private key file type for proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-negotiate
tip: HTTP Negotiate (SPNEGO) auth with the proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-pass
tip: Passphrase for private key for HTTPS proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-pinnedpubkey
tip: FILE/HASHES public key to verify proxy with.

global_option.name: --proxy-ssl-allow-beast
tip: Allow this security flaw for HTTPS proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy-tlsauthtype
tip: TLS authentication type for HTTPS proxy.

global_option.name: --proxy1.0
tip: Use HTTP/1.0 proxy on given port.

global_option.name: --quote
tip: Send command(s) to server before transfer.

global_option.name: --random-file
tip: (deprecated) File for reading random data from.

global_option.name: --range
tip: Retrieve only the bytes within RANGE.

global_option.name: --raw
tip: Do HTTP raw; no transfer decoding.

global_option.name: --remote-name
tip: Write output to file named as remote file.

global_option.name: --remote-name-all
tip: Use the remote filename for all URLs.

global_option.name: --remote-time
tip: Set remote file's time on local output.

global_option.name: --request-target
tip: Specify the target for this request.

global_option.name: --retry
tip: Retry request if transient problems occur.

global_option.name: --show-error
tip: Show error even when -s is used.

global_option.name: --skip-existing
tip: Skip download if local file already exists.

global_option.name: --socks4
tip: SOCKS4 proxy on given host + port.

global_option.name: --socks4a
tip: SOCKS4a proxy on given host + port.

global_option.name: --socks5
tip: SOCKS5 proxy on given host + port.

global_option.name: --socks5-gssapi
tip: Enable GSS-API auth for SOCKS5 proxies.

global_option.name: --socks5-gssapi-service
tip: SOCKS5 proxy service name for GSS-API.

global_option.name: --socks5-hostname
tip: SOCKS5 proxy, pass hostname to proxy.

global_option.name: --ssl-allow-beast
tip: Allow security flaw to improve interop.

global_option.name: --ssl-revoke-best-effort
tip: Ignore missing cert CRL dist points.

global_option.name: --ssl-sessions
tip: Load/save SSL session tickets from/to this file.

global_option.name: --styled-output
tip: Enable styled output for HTTP headers.

global_option.name: --tftp-no-options
tip: Do not send any TFTP options.

global_option.name: --time-cond
tip: Transfer based on a time condition.

global_option.name: --tls-earlydata
tip: Allow use of TLSv1.3 early data (0RTT).

global_option.name: --trace
tip: Write a debug trace to FILE.

global_option.name: --trace-config
tip: Details to log in trace/verbose output.

global_option.name: --trace-ids
tip: Prepend transfer and connection identifiers to each trace or verbose line

global_option.name: --trace-time
tip: Add time stamps to trace/verbose output.

global_option.name: --unix-socket
tip: Connect through this Unix domain socket.

global_option.name: --xattr
tip: Store metadata in extended file attributes.
